title: 2026 international maritime GB-NI parity transition QA

sources.title: UK ETS international maritime voyages consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS scope expansion: maritime sector

facts.source_fact: From July 2026 the Authority will provide a 50% surrender deduction for voyages between Northern Ireland and Great Britain.
The deduction is intended to maintain carbon-pricing equivalence while EU ETS and UK ETS route coverage differs.
The deduction is intended to remain only while the disparity remains.
The international maritime consultation proposes expansion from 2028.
The consultation states the GB-NI 50% deduction would cease when international voyages enter UK ETS scope.
Under the proposal, GB-NI voyages would then face a 100% surrender obligation.
The 2028 international start date is a proposal, not a current legal obligation.
The July 2026 GB-NI deduction is part of confirmed domestic-maritime implementation policy.
The transition is tied to removal of the carbon-pricing disparity rather than a fixed perpetual exemption.
No parcel-level emissions value can be inferred from the route-policy transition.
